rows.definition: Immutable paired Q2_K launch geometry embedding validated single-panel geometry and a doubled X workgroup range for two independent output banks using the same three-int32 push ABI.
rows.distinction: Describes paired launch arithmetic only, unlike the single-output V41Q2KTokenPanelPlan or the constructor that validates and creates this result. It does not record commands or qualify device execution.

rows.definition: Pure constructor reusing Q2_K token-panel shape, row-count and signed byte-bound validation before returning paired geometry with twice the single-panel X workgroup count.
rows.distinction: Constructs host geometry rather than executing a contraction or checking actual device limits; the paired capability query separately determines native availability.

rows.definition: Effect-free optional backend capability query for two same-shape Q2_K contractions sharing one input token panel and producing two independent output panels with unchanged per-workgroup arithmetic.
rows.distinction: Checks selected provider availability and bounded geometry before effects; unlike pure plan construction, it reflects native opt-in, exact module availability and device dispatch limits. It grants no residency, memory budget or speed guarantee.
